Already outer condition false covers case where no registered context; but there they used schema without discriminator. Need case with discriminator present but no context entry.

1. "Discriminator present but no registered context" – ensure no merging, registration.

2. "Both root and schema discriminators have no mapping fields" – ensure no exception, unchanged.

3. "Root mapping present, schema mapping null" – ensure unchanged.

4. "Root mapping null, schema mapping null but discriminator object present (no mapping, no propertyName)" – unchanged.

5. "Merge with overlapping key same value plus new key" – ensure both keys present after.

6. "Context discriminator not an ObjectNode (invalid type) leading to ClassCastException" – expecting ClassCastException.

7. "DiscriminatorOnSchema contains unexpected fields; they are ignored" – ensure no exception and mapping unchanged.
